title: an inferred-fallible function crossing a general callback boundary must spell an explicit Result contract
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Inference': 'Public, abstract, ambient, and declaration-only contracts MUST express fallibility directly with Result<A, E>.' A callback handed to a general higher-order function is such a boundary: the callee's parameter type is `(key: string) => string`, which cannot represent the Missing exit, so the failure channel would be lost. poc/src/language/README.md records SMITHERS1303 for exactly this. Fail-closed: accepting it would let a typed failure vanish at a callback edge.
